feeds.title: Semiconductor Engineering
feeds.description: Semiconductor Engineering was created by chip architects, engineers, journalists, end-users, industry organizations and standards bodies to provide deep insights into the increasingly complex task of designing, testing, verifying, integrating and manufacturing semiconductors, as well as insights into the market dynamics that make it all possible.

feeds.title: Semiconductor Today News
feeds.description: News for the compound semiconductor and advanced silicon industry. The first choice for professionals who demand timely focused top-quality coverage of the compound semiconductor industry.

feeds.title: SemiWiki.com
feeds.description: SemiWiki.com, the open forum for semiconductor professionals, is a leading online community of people involved with electronic devices and the semiconductor design and manufacturing ecosystem.

feeds.title: Nordic Semiconductor Blog
feeds.description: Nordic Semiconductor ASA is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in ultra-low power short-range wireless communication.

feeds.title: KES Systems
feeds.description: KES Systems, based in Dallas Texas, is a burn-in board manufacturer and the leader in burn-in technology and services for the semiconductor industry.

feeds.title: SemiAnalysis
feeds.description: Bridging the gap between business and the world's most important industry. Click to read SemiAnalysis, by Dylan Patel, a Substack publication with thousands of readers.

feeds.title: Tech Xplore » Electronics & Semiconductors
feeds.description: The latest news on electronics and semiconductor technology developments. Tech Xplore, a division of Science X Network, covers the latest engineering, electronics, and technology advances.

feeds.title: EETimes » Semiconductors
feeds.description: The following section of EETimes features articles, news, and more on Semiconductor. EE Times offers design engineers and management executives news and analysis of the latest technologies and business developments in the global electronics industry. Award-winning journalists and subject matter experts strive to cover not just what happened today, but why it happened and how it transpired.

feeds.title: EEJournal » Semiconductor
feeds.description: Electronic Engineering Journal is your source to read articles on Semiconductors and stay updated on the latest news, updates, reports, and more. The journal is here to provide independent insight and analysis (with a sense of humor) on the fast-paced world of electronic design for a worldwide engineering audience.

feeds.title: AnySilicon
feeds.description: Founded in 2011, AnySilicon is the best way to explore, find and contact semiconductor service providers and IP vendors online. Our vision is to be the first place ASIC engineers and decision-makers go to search for semiconductor service providers and IP core vendors. In addition to that, AnySilicon offers a wealth of knowledge and best practices including technical articles and news to help users gain knowledge that will allow them to make smaller and cheaper chips.

feeds.title: Fabricated Knowledge
feeds.description: Hey! I'm Doug. This is a place where you can get plain English explainers of semiconductor companies and what they do from an investment focus. I want to help save you time on semiconductor research as well as teach you something along the way.

feeds.title: Planet Analog
feeds.description: Planet Analog provides an online community for semiconductor and system designers/engineers interested in advancing analog design techniques.

feeds.title: DIGITIMES » Semiconductors
feeds.description: The site offers a dedicated section on semiconductor news featuring industry-wide coverage of manufacturing, memory chips, design, distribution, and supply-chain trends. It provides timely commentary on major shifts such as AI-driven demand, pricing surges, and regional developments in the chip business.

feeds.title: IEEE Spectrum » Semiconductors
feeds.description: The semiconductors section of IEEE Spectrum shares news and insights on chip design, processors, memory technologies, nanotechnology, and breakthroughs shaping the future of electronics and computing.

feeds.title: Orbit & Skyline Blogs
feeds.description: Orbit & Skyline's blog offers deep-dive insights into the semiconductor industry, covering topics such as global fab trends, obsolescence management, compound semiconductors, sustainability in chip manufacturing, and how semiconductors impact everyday life.

feeds.title: Applied SmartFactory » Semiconductor Blog
feeds.description: The Applied SmartFactory blog offers in-depth articles on smart manufacturing in the semiconductor industry. It covers topics such as factory automation, MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems), productivity improvements, scheduling and dispatch optimization, chip-manufacturing use cases, and the impact of AI/ML in semiconductor operations.

feeds.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific Blog » Materials
feeds.description: Spectroscopy, spectrometry, and materials science stories and solutions about advancing research and improving product development

feeds.title: THE ELEC » Semiconductor
feeds.description: The Elec is a South Korea-based online news platform that covers the electronics industry, focusing on semiconductors, display panels, batteries, and technology. It provides regular updates on major companies like Samsung and SK Hynix and features detailed coverage of supply chains and product developments from its base in Gangnam, Seoul.

feeds.title: Evertiq
feeds.description: Evertiq is a news and media platform focused on the electronics and semiconductor industries, providing up-to-date coverage of market trends, technology developments, and company news.

feeds.title: Millennium Semiconductors Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated with the latest insights and trends in the semiconductor industry on Millennium Semiconductor's informative blog platform.

feeds.title: Black Semiconductor Blog
feeds.description: The Black Semiconductor blog shares updates on the company's work in graphene-based photonics and chip connectivity. It includes news about their new headquarters in Aachen, Germany, major funding milestones, and insights from their leadership team on advancing semiconductor technology.

feeds.title: SignOff Semiconductors Blog
feeds.description: The blog section of SignOff Semiconductors offers in-depth technical articles on semiconductor design topics, including CMOS basics, floor planning, routing optimization, and the physical design flow.

feeds.title: Schneider Electric Blog » Semiconductor
feeds.description: The Schneider Electric Semiconductor Blog focuses on topics related to the semiconductor manufacturing industry, including power reliability, cybersecurity, sustainability, and operational efficiency in wafer fabs. It offers insights on decarbonization strategies, energy management, and cost optimization within semiconductor plants. The content highlights Schneider Electric's expertise in automation and sustainable manufacturing, providing quick, informative reads for professionals interested in the industrial and energy aspects of semiconductor production.

feeds.title: Semiconductor Digest
feeds.description: Through a mix of news, contributed articles, and staff-written articles, Semiconductor Digest is dedicated to providing information about the design, manufacturing, packaging, and testing of semiconductors and other types of electronic devices. Our focus is on the unique requirements of each of these devices in terms of the design tools, process equipment and materials, and test equipment.

feeds.title: Future Bridge Americas Blog
feeds.description: The Future Bridge Americas blog features expert insights and articles on semiconductors, battery manufacturing, gigafactory design, and data center infrastructure. It focuses on industry trends, innovation, and technology developments shaping the future of these sectors.

feeds.title: GlobalFoundries Blog
feeds.description: The GlobalFoundries blog shares updates on semiconductor manufacturing, new technologies, workforce development, and industry innovations, highlighting the company's role in advancing global chip production.

feeds.title: Hemlock Semiconductor
feeds.description: Hemlock Semiconductor produces high-purity polysilicon used in semiconductors and solar panels. Its news section shares updates on manufacturing developments, partnerships, investments, and company growth.

feeds.title: Phoenix Blog
feeds.description: Phoenix Semiconductor Corporation recreates obsolete microelectronic components on demand and at scale, particularly for mission-critical applications in defense, infrastructure, oil & gas, and transportation. Their blog covers company news, product announcements, industry insights and engineering perspectives.

feeds.title: Polar Semiconductor
feeds.description: Since the world of semiconductor production moves quickly, stay up-to-date on the most recent industry news by reading our in-depth blogs.

feeds.title: ON Semiconductor
feeds.description: ON Semiconductor is a Fortune 500 company driving energy efficient innovations, empowering customers to reduce global energy use. The company is a leading supplier of semiconductor-based solutions, offering a comprehensive portfolio of energy-efficient power and signal management, logic, standard and custom devices.

feeds.title: Shin-Etsu MicroSi Blog
feeds.description: Looking for the latest and greatest in microelectronic & semiconductor industry news? Visit our Shin-Etsu MicroSi blog for your silicone & non-silicone grease resources today!

feeds.title: Semiconductor Club Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest trends, technology, research of the Semiconductor Industry. Semiconductor Club is the dedicated eLearning community and marketplace for semiconductor enthusiasts. We are on a mission to bridging the gap between semiconductor domain students, professionals, institutes and companies by creating a learning ecosystem.

feeds.title: Oricus Semicon Solutions Blog
feeds.description: A Semiconductor Blog focusing on topics like Advanced Packaging, Bond Test, Dicing, Die Attach, and Wire Bond. Oricus Semicon Solutions is an innovative Semiconductor Tools manufacturing company that crafts high-tech bespoke tooling solutions for the global Semiconductor Assembly and Test industry.

feeds.title: VLSI UNIVERSE
feeds.description: VLSI Universe is a technical blog that focuses on VLSI design, physical design, static timing analysis, and semiconductor engineering topics. It offers explanations, tutorials, and interview guidance on concepts like design for test, clock gating, scan chains, and other chip design processes.

feeds.title: eInfochips » Semiconductor
feeds.description: eInfochips, an Arrow company, is a product engineering and semiconductor design services firm, specializing in digital transformation and connected IoT solutions across various cloud platforms.

feeds.title: The Memory Guy
feeds.description: Jim Handy, a well-known semiconductor industry analyst, began his career in design and marketing positions at leading technology firms including National Semiconductor, Intel, and Siemens. Mr. Handy has written hundreds of articles, white papers, and in-depth reports for trade journals and market research firms. He is often quoted in the electronics press, presents frequently at trade shows, and is known for his high level of industry presence and volume of publication.

feeds.title: ROHM CO Blog
feeds.description: The blog section of ROHM shares detailed articles on semiconductor-industry topics, covering innovations in power devices, sensors, analog ICs, and manufacturing trends. It features content on applications such as automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics, highlighting both product developments and broader technology shifts.
